title: Staff Management
description: Apni store team, attendance aur salary manage karo

attendance.markDescription: Apni active team members ki daily attendance record karo.
attendance.formHint: Attendance selected date ke liye save hoti hai.
attendance.empty: Is mahine ke liye koi attendance record nahi hai.
attendance.noActiveStaff: Koi active staff member nahi mila. Attendance mark karne se pehle team members add ya activate karo.

salary.recordDescription: Active team member ke liye salary payment record karo.
salary.formHint: Salary selected pay period ke liye record hoti hai.
salary.noActiveStaff: Koi active staff member nahi mila. Salary record karne se pehle team members add ya activate karo.
salary.loading: Salary payments load ho rahe hain...
salary.empty: Is mahine ke liye koi salary payment record nahi hai.
salary.noAttendanceConfirm: Is pay period ke liye attendance nahi mili. Phir bhi salary record karne ke liye confirm karo.
